title: Seas The Day, Boat Rentals
specs: Lake Pleasant is beginner-friendly with wide open cruising space and calm coves
Popular for birthdays, bachelorette parties, family gatherings, corporate outings
Located 35-40 minutes from Phoenix and Scottsdale
Must be 18+ with valid ID to rent
No boating license required in Arizona
Operator must remain sober if alcohol is consumed unless a captain is hired
Boats accommodate from 1 up to 25 people depending on model
Captained boats recommended for large parties and alcohol events
includes: Fuel included on Pink Party Barge and Destination Yacht
blurb: Seas The Day offers boat rentals on Lake Pleasant, Arizona, for groups ranging from small to large parties. Rentals include self-guided and captained options with a safety orientation provided before launch. Popular uses include birthdays, bachelorette parties, family gatherings, and corporate outings.
extraNote: Book 2-3 weeks ahead for peak weekends, 2-3 months ahead for bachelorette parties · Alcohol allowed for passengers 21+, driver must stay sober or hire captain · 10-Lane Boat Ramp, Lake Pleasant Regional Park, near Scorpion Bay Marina · April through October
